content:
The age of the universe is approximately **13.8 billion years**.

This estimate comes from multiple lines of evidence, including:

- Observations of the cosmic microwave background radiation (especially from missions like WMAP and Planck)
- Measurements of the expansion rate of the universe (Hubble constant)
- Studies of the oldest stars and globular clusters
- Analysis of the large-scale structure of the universe

The most precise current measurement from the Planck space telescope puts it at 13.787 ± 0.020 billion years, though you'll often see it rounded to 13.8 billion years.
